# LeadsPitch
> Verified B2B lead data delivered as CSV. Buy one-time datasets or save with membership across 19+ industry niches.

## What We Sell
- [Industry Datasets](https://leadspitch.com/industries): Verified business contact data by niche — emails, phone numbers, company details
- [Bundles](https://leadspitch.com/bundles): Multi-niche data packs at discounted rates
- [Membership](https://leadspitch.com/membership): 40% off all datasets with a membership plan

## Key Facts
- One-time purchases, no subscription required
- CSV/Excel format, ready to use
- Verified email addresses included
- 19+ industry niches: Automotive, Clinics, Construction, Dentists, Education, Real Estate, Legal, Logistics, and more
- Direct human support

## Pricing
- Individual datasets start from $49
- Bundle packs save up to 30%
- Membership saves 40% on all datasets
